description: Should I pay this x402 URL? allow / warn / block with coded reasons, from Lumi's daily CDP Bazaar index, free 402-quote checks and Lumi's own test-buys (Base USDC for Bazaar listings; XRPL only for a small curated vendor list, counted separately). Live: after payment Lumi contacts the seller once (an unpaid request; Lumi never pays the seller) and compares its current quote, price, payTo and TLS with Lumi's record, returned as live with signed live_evidence; the free check is cached and shows data_age. Pass url, and optionally the payTo and USD amount you were quoted, to catch address or price mismatches. Links the free lookup and, for curated vendors, the $0.02 full report. Observations, not a guarantee. Paid: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base, or XRP/RLUSD/USDC on the XRP Ledger). Pays with your own wallet via x402 (XRPL_SEED or EVM_PRIVATE_KEY) within the configured caps.

amount.description: Optional: the quoted price in USD, e.g. 0.01

payTo.description: Optional: the payTo address in its 402 quote

url.description: The x402 resource URL you are about to pay
